title: I rebuilt Anthropic's leaked daemon features in cortextOS
description: Anthropic leaked their unreleased Claude Code features when their codebase leaked, so I rebuilt them before they could ship. The leak pointed to a daemon they call Kairos, a 24/7 process that keeps a persistent Claude Code session alive with scheduled workers and phone push notifications. I reproduced all of it in cortextOS, except mine lets every agent message and talk to each other in the background, and you run the whole thing from Telegram on your phone. Link in bio.
